name: @parlamentsdienste/source
description: Component Library for Swiss Parliamentary Services

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:angular-output-target && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:angular && pnpm run build:react && pnpm run build:vue && pnpm run build:storybook
scripts.clean:dist: rm -rf dist packages/core/dist packages/vue/dist packages/angular/dist packages/react/dist libs/angular-output-target/dist docs/storybook-static apps/angular-test/dist apps/react-test/dist apps/vue-test/dist
scripts.pack:core: rm -rf dist/core && mkdir -p dist/core && find packages/core/dist -maxdepth 2 -name '*.tgz' -delete && pnpm --dir packages/core pack --pack-destination ../../dist/core
scripts.pack:angular: rm -rf dist/angular && mkdir -p dist/angular && find packages/angular/dist -maxdepth 2 -name '*.tgz' -delete && pnpm --dir packages/angular/dist pack --pack-destination ../../../dist/angular
scripts.pack:react: rm -rf dist/react && mkdir -p dist/react && find packages/react/dist -maxdepth 2 -name '*.tgz' -delete && pnpm --dir packages/react pack --pack-destination ../../dist/react
scripts.pack:vue: rm -rf dist/vue && mkdir -p dist/vue && find packages/vue/dist -maxdepth 2 -name '*.tgz' -delete && pnpm --dir packages/vue pack --pack-destination ../../dist/vue
scripts.pack:all: npm run pack:core && npm run pack:angular && npm run pack:react && npm run pack:vue
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:core && npm run publish:angular && npm run publish:react && npm run publish:vue
